title: Taste and Trails Tour in Gatineau Park
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Escape the city for a perfect blend of nature and flavor on our Tastes and Trails tour. Leaving Ottawa behind, we will journey to historic Old Chelsea for a refreshing one-hour hike along the scenic Sugarbush Trail. This gentle, tree-lined path offers the perfect opportunity to breathe in the fresh air and immerse yourself in Gatineau Park's tranquil beauty. After working up an appetite, we will gather at La Terrasse to indulge in a delicious, well-deserved lunch. It is the ultimate half-day getaway for food lovers and outdoor enthusiasts alike.
